title: Game Modes
description: See how Star Atlas organizes combat, traversal, open-world play, and competitive depth into a clearer gameplay portfolio.
heroTitle: Variety only feels premium when it still reads as one product.
heroSummary: This page reframes the gameplay portfolio so visitors understand the range without feeling like they are looking at unrelated prototypes or disconnected modes.
utilityLine: The goal here is synthesis: explain multiple experiences while preserving one cohesive product story.

heroMedia.poster: src/GAME section/3rd Person Experience/Thumbnails in carousel/Slide_2_ImageThumbnail.png
heroMedia.label: Gameplay preview
heroMedia.caption: A tighter explanation of range, structure, and player choice.

heroPanel.title: Each mode now has a job in the story.
heroPanel.body: Instead of listing features, the redesign explains why each mode exists and what kind of player energy it serves.

sections.heading: A clearer map of the gameplay spectrum.

cards.title: Arena combat
cards.body: Fast, legible conflict built for skill expression and direct comparison.

cards.title: Racing and movement
cards.body: Ship handling becomes a spectacle and a mastery loop, not just transit.

cards.title: PvE encounters
cards.body: Structured missions and escalating opposition add purpose beyond pure rivalry.

cards.title: Open-world operations
cards.body: The larger frontier remains the canvas where consequence accumulates.

sections.heading: The site no longer makes the visitor stitch the experience together alone.
body: A premium marketing page should curate meaning. This redesign explains the relationship between high-intensity modes and the larger world so the visitor understands the product as a system.
That shift reduces the feeling of fragmentation and gives each page a clearer next step.
sections.asideTitle: Mode pages should answer one question.
sections.asideBody: What kind of experience does this deliver, and who is it for?

items.question: Why not list every future mode or edge case?
items.answer: Because trust improves when the page explains what matters now and how the product is structured, not when it overwhelms the reader with speculative detail.

items.question: How does this connect back to the economy and universe?
items.answer: Modes are now framed as expressions of the same world, with progression, ownership, and faction context surrounding them.

finalCta.title: Follow the mode that matches your play style.
finalCta.text: Move into ship ownership, fleet command, or the wider universe depending on how you want to engage.
